subject: Deployment-mode decision: MAP, eval plan, and region constraints
messages:
From: Alex Lin <alex.lin@novacare.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novacare.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation & MAP for deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Kim — thanks for the intro last week. We discussed internally and want to surface the hosting constraints up front so we can build a clean MAP and agree on a pilot timeline. High level: Novacare needs EU data residency for all patient-identifiable requests (medical notes ingestion and query), SOC 2 evidence, and an option to escalate to a private on-prem deployment if the PoC shows performance/regulatory gaps.

Can you send a suggested Mutual Action Plan (milestones + owners + decision gates) that covers:
- pilot scope and acceptance criteria for hosted in EU region,
- what would push us to purchase Dedicated capacity vs staying on Hosted,
- a clear escape hatch and timeline to Private deployment (including rough cost/time estimates),
- any minimal security evidence you can attach (SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS notes).

Our procurement deadline for initial commitment is 2026-06-18. If we can have a draft MAP and pilot checklist by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-03) we can review with legal & security. Also include a brief pricing band for each mode so our finance team can model TCO.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Lin
Head of Integrations, Novacare Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lin <alex.lin@novacare.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & MAP for deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Alex — appreciate the clear ask. Draft MAP attached (novacare_MAP_draft.pdf) and a SOC2 one-pager (soc2-summary.pdf). Below is a concise summary and proposed milestones — happy to iterate.

Draft MAP (summary)
- Week 0: Kick / alignment call (30m) — owners: Kimberly (Redwood), Alex (Novacare).
- Week 1–2: PoC (Hosted in EU region) — goals: verify data residency flows, run 100k token/day workload, validate latency under 220ms p50 for conversational endpoints. Owner: Dylan (Redwood).
- Week 3–4: Load validation & security review — run spike with sample production traffic, confirm SOC2 artifacts and encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration smoke test. Owner: Karthik (Redwood) + Novacare security.
- Decision gate A (end of Week 4): If performance and compliance met -> proceed to limited production on Hosted EU; else -> evaluate Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) timeline.
- Week 5–8 (if Dedicated chosen): Dedicated sizing, procurement, and capacity test (expected 4–6 week lead for reserved capacity depending on region). Owner: Laura (Redwood sales ops).
- Private/on-prem: estimated 8–12 weeks after contract + additional ops handoff (air-gap options available). Decision gate B: only if regulatory or perf blockers remain.

Success criteria for PoC -> list: EU residency verified, latency ci under threshold, no major security gaps, regression-free model outputs on sample eval set.

Pricing bands (high level) attached in pricing-comparison.xlsx — ranges only: Hosted (usage) | Dedicated (monthly commit) | Private (one-time infra + license). We will refine after we confirm expected qps and model choice.

Next steps:
- I can send an editable MAP doc and propose a Wed 6/2 10:00–10:30AM CEST alignment call.
- Please confirm which EU geofence/region you must restrict to (e.g. eu-west-1 vs eu-central-1) and whether Novacare will provide a KMS endpoint or you need Redwood-managed keys/HSM.

Attachments: novacare_MAP_draft.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf, pricing-comparison.xlsx

— Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Rene Keller <rene.keller@novacare.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Lin <alex.lin@novacare.com>, procurement@novacare.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & MAP for deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Kimberly / team — quick clarifications from procurement/security after reviewing your draft:
1) Region: we must host all PHI processing in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) due to our contracts with EU hospitals. Non-PHI traffic can be routed to other regions; we need a documented fallback plan.
2) KMS/HSM: prefer Novacare-managed CMK in our Azure tenancy if possible (we have an HSM-backed key already). If Redwood cannot integrate, provide explicit steps and timeline to enable Redwood-managed HSM with customer key wrapping.
3) Pilot data retention: default 30 days unless longer is negotiated — please include how cache/kv prefix removal will be handled at PoC end.
4) For Dedicated vs Hosted trigger: procurement wants a concrete throughput/cost threshold that triggers a recommended Dedicated buy (e.g., sustained >X RPS or >Y tokens/month or costs > $Z). Please add an explicit numeric threshold in MAP v1.

We also want a minimal canary strategy for production cutover (traffic split plan + rollback triggers). Can you add a paragraph for that?

If you can update the MAP and send a call invite for Thu 6/3 09:00 CET (we prefer morning) that would help us hit our procurement window.

Thanks — Rene
Rene Keller
Sr. Procurement Manager, Novacare Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rene Keller <rene.keller@novacare.com>, Alex Lin <alex.lin@novacare.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & MAP for deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private)

Rene / Alex — thanks for the clarity. We updated the MAP to include:
- region pinning to eu-central-1 for PHI endpoints (hosted EU region) and explicit fallback to us-west-2 for non-PII analytics traffic;
- KMS integration options: 1) Novacare-managed CMK (preferred) — we will perform a quick integration smoke test (1–3 business days) once credentials/peering are in place; 2) Redwood-managed HSM with customer key wrap (estimated 5–8 business days to enable and test).
- Pilot data retention & cache removal: default 30-day retention; we will schedule a live cache purge at PoC end and run verification scripts (audit logs included).
- Dedicated trigger (numeric threshold): recommended at sustained >1.2M tokens/day or predicted monthly cost > $85k — both thresholds are configurable and we'll map to your expected QPS during the kickoff.
- Canary plan: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% over 48h with auto-rollback on error rate >1.5% or latency p99 > 1s.

Next steps:
- I attached the updated MAP doc and a short pricing band spreadsheet.
- Proposed call: Thu 2026-06-03 09:00 CET — if that doesn't work we can do Fri 6/4 09:00 CET.

Quote from your earlier mail: 
> "Our procurement deadline for initial commitment is 2026-06-18."

We can meet that cadence provided we align on the PoC scope this week. Dylan and Karthik are on standby to run the EU PoC the week of 6/7 if we confirm region access.

Can we lock Thu 6/3 09:00 CET or Fri 6/4 09:00 CET? I will send the calendar invite once you confirm.

— Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
